kjv: When a man shall make a singular vow
mine: When anyone makes a special vow
note: yafli' neder means "makes an extraordinary or special vow". "Singular" now means "single".

kjv: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death
mine: No one devoted ... from among mankind, shall be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death
note: cherem of persons means those placed under the ban of destruction (e.g., in war or by judicial sentence). Both translations are literal. The KJV's "of men" leaves unclear whether it means a person someone has vowed or a person condemned.
